validity_findings.finding: Target/split/sampling design coherent but externally narrow — if unblocked, environment could express effect within stated ceiling only
validity_findings.detail: Frozen design: 10 JSONPlaceholder tasks T1-T10 spanning 0/25/50/75/100% novelty by construction (T1 identical, T2-T3 same endpoint different ID, T4-T5 different endpoint same resource, T6-T7 different resource same API, T8-T10 unseen structure/POST/PUT). Split: 6 tasks x3 reps=18 observations per condition in primary 25-75% range, 120 total executions, 5000-sample paired bootstrap two-sided alpha 0.05. Sampling: each task×condition executed independently with fresh LLM context, randomized order, no cross-contamination per spec/prereg 7-8. Representation loss acknowledged: JSONPlaceholder is synthetic REST API with deterministic JSON responses, no DOM, no auth, no multi-step browser interaction; prereg 10.2 notes 'JSONPlaceholder simplicity' and 'REST API only (no DOM)' as ceilings. Cost weighting M-TOTAL-COST = TOKENS+10*BROWSER+5*VERIFY is arbitrary (prereg 10.3 notes sensitivity analysis required). If unblocked, the design could discriminate cost within this synthetic API ceiling at n=18 per condition for medium effects (d>0.5) but cannot support claims about real Web DOM, WebArena, or cross-site transfer without replication.

baseline_findings.expected: Cold exploration: LLM with no prior knowledge, prompted only with task goal + general Web navigation instructions. Should succeed via exploration at highest cost. If SPIDER cannot beat cold, mechanism inheritance provides no value (spec baselines[0] rationale).
baseline_findings.observed: Not executed (0/30 executions for B-COLD: 10 tasks x3 reps). No token/browser/verify measurements. Producer reports no baselines run. Audit independently verified 0 executions due to missing API key; no partial data to assess baseline strength empirically.
baseline_findings.issue: Design baseline is appropriately zero-knowledge and strong for cost comparison, but untested. Strength cannot be validated without real LLM calls. No evidence of prompt adequacy or failure mode on JSONPlaceholder.

baseline_findings.expected: Literal trajectory replay: exact action sequence from prior successful trajectory (e.g., GET https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts/1 -> verify 200 -> extract body). Represents commoditized exact-workflow replay (TERX/HyperAgent/BrowserBash). Tests whether parameterization adds value over literal replay.
baseline_findings.observed: Not executed (0/30). No measurement of literal replay cost/success on novel IDs/endpoints. Design expects literal to be optimal at 0% novelty (PC-IDENTICAL) and to fail/overfit at 25-75% novelty.
baseline_findings.issue: Design baseline correctly contrasts commoditized replay; untested. Whether literal replay with LLM adaptation vs strict replay matters is underspecified in prereg 4.2, but design is adequate for hypothesis.

baseline_findings.expected: Semantic retrieval over trajectories: top-3 similar prior trajectories via cosine similarity over task descriptions, agent must adapt retrieved trajectories to current task. Represents RAG-over-trajectories strongest memory baseline (WebCoach/HMT). Tests mechanism-level vs trajectory-level inheritance.
baseline_findings.observed: Not executed (0/30). No retrieval latency/cost, no similarity threshold, no adaptation success data. Embedding model not specified in spec (prereg 10.1 notes 'same embedding model' but without identifier).
baseline_findings.issue: Design baseline is the strongest memory baseline and appropriate strong null for C-LLM-INHERIT, but underspecified embedding implementation and untested retrieval quality on JSONPlaceholder task descriptions (which are highly similar). If unblocked, retrieval may overlap heavily with literal.

baseline_findings.expected: SPIDER parameterized mechanism inheritance: agent provided with parameterized mechanism (template GET .../posts/${post_id} with parameters {post_id:5}, pre/postconditions, verification). Executes mechanism with bound parameters. Treatment condition for hypothesis.
baseline_findings.observed: Not executed (0/30). No mechanism induction verification (training on T1-T3) performed, no binding correctness, no cost. Depends on graph lane mechanism induction functional on JSONPlaceholder (spec dependencies, EXP-GRAPH-33528827169 substrate). Prior graph experiments show substrate was BROKEN/COMPETITION-UNSAFE in parts, but audit notes dependency established for synthetic single-parameter case only.
baseline_findings.issue: Treatment untested. Whether mechanism induction would produce correct template/conditions for JSONPlaceholder is not verified in this run; prior product audits (EXP-PRODUCT-33528829801) show single-parameter common-prefix heuristic works only for narrow synthetic POC, not multi-parameter. Risk that B-SPIDER condition would be mis-parameterized if induction fails, but that would be valid measurement not design flaw.
